name: grades_list
description: Read one page of normalized CS101 grade records, keyed by user_id and paper_id. Defaults to all_user=true and latest=true; the token determines upstream permissions. Context is opt-in. No inferred full score. Gateway requests are GET-only to the activation-configured HTTPS origin; it never follows redirects or contacts iaaa.gbu.edu.cn. Browser authentication, including session reuse and any SSO navigation, uses visible Chromium only.
